changes.summary: Refreshed the pinned core runtime to ComfyUI 0.34.0.
changes.details: The source bundle now hash-locks stable tag v0.34.0 at exact commit 12d52794 and its verified source archive. Model artifacts, core-node workflow parameters, admission envelopes, and Candidate qualification are unchanged.

changes.summary: Added the official INT8 tensorwise ConvRot Qwen Image Edit 2511 Candidate for one Spark.
changes.details: The isolated stock-ComfyUI source bundle installs the exact 20.50 GB INT8 ConvRot transformer plus immutable scaled-FP8 encoder and VAE, pins the official non-turbo shift-3.1 40-step Euler/simple workflow, accepts one or two signed reference images and a bounded prompt, and publishes exactly one PNG. Its 108.00 GB unified-memory and 95.14 GB peak installation-disk envelopes fit one 128 GB Spark, while physical quality, latency, and peak-memory acceptance remain pending.
